item.title: ITEMATE Add-On
item.creator: The World Foundry
item.description:
Take away the hard work of managing your inventory.
- Armor automatically equips
- Hotbar slots replenish, and choose best weapon/axe/pickaxe
- Chest/Hopper/etc. capacity reports
- Auto-place your torches
- Creative chests auto-fill items
- Filtered item offload
- Magnets!
item.changelog: Added How to Play and FAQ

faqEntries.heading: How do I disable Combat Camera
faqEntries.content:
Equip a sword and use it to cycle back to first person view.

If the feature is disabled in the Guide configuration settings, re-enable it to cycle the views back to first-person view.

faqEntries.heading: When I place a chest in Creative, why does it fill with random items?
faqEntries.content:
This feature may be disabled or re-enabled in the Guide configuration. It is intended for Map Makers to allow them to place populated chests around their builds when in Creative mode.

This feature does not run in Survival or Adventure mode.

howToEntries.heading: FIRST STEP - ENABLE ITEMATE
howToEntries.content:
When you spawn in, open the Guide and enable ITEMATE using the "Yes Please" button.

Check the available configuration options. You can enable or disable sounds, title notifications, and chat messages. For each ITEMATE feature there is a tooltip explaining what the feature does and a toggle that lets you switch it off or on.

You can disable ITEMATE any time using the Guide, and re-enable it when you need it later.

howToEntries.heading: AUTO-EQUIP ARMOR
howToEntries.content: Whenever you have a free armor slot, ITEMATE will equip the 'best' armor for that slot. This is useful when an armor item breaks in combat and you don't have time to hunt in your inventory for a replacement.

howToEntries.heading: AUTO-REPLENISH WITH GRAVITY
howToEntries.content:
The simplest and most powerful ITEMATE feature you can use is to assign each slot a GRAVITY rule. This causes the item or weapon in your inventory to fall down into the hotbar slot whenever it is empty. If you run out of something, it will be quickly replaced.

You can use this when adventuring, farming, or building.
